# v0.1.24

## 中文

### 重要：插件标识更名
- 插件 id 由 `grok-inspection` 更名为 **`hk-grok-inspection`**，避免与插件商店中的同名标识冲突
- 升级后请将 CPA 配置中 `plugins.configs` 的插件键名同步改为 `hk-grok-inspection`，并替换插件目录中的旧 `.so` / `.dll` / `.dylib` 文件（Release 产物名同步更名）
- 旧默认路径 `data/grok-inspection/bans.json` 中的封禁状态会在升级后首次启动时**自动迁移**到 `data/hk-grok-inspection/bans.json`（旧文件重命名为 `.migrated`，不会重复导入）
- 管理路由前缀由 `/plugins/grok-inspection/...` 变为 `/plugins/hk-grok-inspection/...`；旧收藏的书签链接需要更新

### 修复
- **修复巡检全部返回 HTTP 426**：探测客户端版本不再硬编码 `0.2.93`（低于 cli-chat-proxy 服务端下限 `1.0.13`），改为从 npm registry（`@xai-official/grok/latest`）后台动态获取，每 3 小时刷新
  - 兜底版本 `1.0.46`（npm latest），npm 不可达时探测照常工作
  - 请求经 CPA 的 `host.http.do` 通道，自动跟随 CPA 代理配置
  - 预发布版本（如 `1.1.0-alpha.1`）与低于下限的版本一律拒用
- HTTP 426 明确归类为 `probe_error` / `keep`：这是插件侧缺陷，永不建议禁用/删除账号

## English

### Important: plugin identity renamed
- Plugin id renamed from `grok-inspection` to **`hk-grok-inspection`** to avoid colliding with the same-named id in the plugin store
- After upgrading, rename the plugin key under `plugins.configs` in your CPA config to `hk-grok-inspection` and replace the old `.so` / `.dll` / `.dylib` file in the plugin directory (release artifact names renamed accordingly)
- Ban state at the old default path `data/grok-inspection/bans.json` is **auto-migrated** to `data/hk-grok-inspection/bans.json` on first start after the upgrade (the legacy file is renamed `.migrated` and never re-imported)
- The management route prefix changed from `/plugins/grok-inspection/...` to `/plugins/hk-grok-inspection/...`; update saved bookmarks

### Fixed
- **Fixed inspections all failing with HTTP 426**: the probe client version is no longer hardcoded to `0.2.93` (below the cli-chat-proxy server floor `1.0.13`); it is now fetched in the background from the npm registry (`@xai-official/grok/latest`) and refreshed every 3 hours
  - Fallback version `1.0.46` (npm latest); probing keeps working when npm is unreachable
  - Requests go through CPA's `host.http.do` channel and inherit the CPA proxy configuration
  - Prerelease versions (e.g. `1.1.0-alpha.1`) and versions below the floor are always rejected
- HTTP 426 is now classified explicitly as `probe_error` / `keep`: it is a plugin-side defect and never recommends disabling or deleting accounts
